titles.english: Assassination Classroom the Movie: Our Time
titles.native: 暗殺教室 みんなの時間

description:
A new movie to commemorate Assassination Classroom's 10th anniversary of the TV anime. It adapts episodes previously omitted in the original anime series.

As graduation nears, Class 3-E reflects on their year with Koro Sensei and the lessons he'll leave behind.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
